summary: Iter 54 — 3 approved features: (1) 4 new always-on house games, (2) Reservation Manager screen, (3) Gift Card balance Redeem. BACKEND (pytest test_iter54_house_reservations_redeem.py — 10 passed / 3 skipped): GET /api/games_v2/play_and_win → unlocked_for_you contains all 4 new house campaigns (cmp_house_scratch/mystery/memory/word); each is playable via POST /api/games_v2/campaigns/{cid}/start + /sessions/{sid}/submit with the correct template payload (returns result=win|lose). Bookings: /bookings/mine returns items with `status` and `available_slots`; POST /bookings/{id}/reschedule with valid slot returns 200 and persists (verified via GET); bad slot → 400 `bad_slot`; unknown id → 404. POST /bookings/{id}/cancel flips status→cancelled and is idempotent (second call also 200). Gift Card /redeem: valid amount deducts from balance_cents; balance_cents > amount → 400 `insufficient_balance`; redeeming full balance sets status=`spent`. The 3 skipped redeem tests were self-skipped by the fixture because after prior curl+pytest runs the demo's only card had balance_cents=0 and points_balance (948) < min denom (1000) — earlier full run passed 12/12, and functionality was independently verified by the mobile UI flow below. MOBILE (Expo web preview 390x844, demo login): /games — all 4 game-card-cmp_house_{scratch,mystery,memory,word} render in the 'MORE GAMES LIVE NOW' grid; no duplicate trivia/lyric cards (those live in Quick Games section). Tapping game-card-cmp_house_scratch navigates to /game/cmp_house_scratch (generic player). /bookings — bookings-reminder banner is present + tappable and routes to /reservations. /reservations — reservations-root renders; 3 bookings shown with res-<booking_id> + res-reschedule-* + res-cancel-*; tapping Reschedule reveals 3 res-slot-<bid>-<slot> chips; tapping the '9:00 PM' chip successfully reschedules the first booking (visible in after-screenshot: slot changed from 6:00 PM → 9:00 PM). Cancel action fires (verified by backend test — cancelled bookings drop from /bookings/mine list per query filter status!=cancelled). /giftcards My Cards — seeded card gc_qa_iter54 with $10 balance renders; gc-redeem-gc_qa_iter54 opens amount input gc-redeem-amt-gc_qa_iter54; entering '3' and tapping gc-redeem-confirm-gc_qa_iter54 ticks gc-balance-gc_qa_iter54 from '$10' → '$7'.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/merchant_marketplace.py:829-843 — GET /api/bookings/mine excludes cancelled bookings via `status: {$ne: 'cancelled'}`. This means the mobile /reservations screen can never show a `cancelled` status pill after the user cancels (the item just disappears). The mobile code in /app/mobile/app/reservations.tsx:93-95 has UI for a `cancelled` status pill that is effectively unreachable. Either return cancelled items and let the mobile filter (better UX — user sees 'Cancelled' confirmation before it fades) or remove the dead cancel-pill UI.

backend/routes/merchant_marketplace.py:879-889 — cancel_booking does not verify booking ownership on the update (only on the initial find_one). Safe here because the find_one already scoped by user_id, but the update should double-scope (`{'booking_id': booking_id, 'user_id': uid}`) for defence-in-depth against race conditions.

backend/routes/gift_cards.py:279-301 — /redeem has NO ownership check that the actor is spending their OWN card in a checkout context — anyone with a card_id they own (or was gifted to their email) can redeem any partial amount. There is no coupling to a merchant/POS session, so a compromised token could drain a card. Consider requiring a merchant_id + POS session token in the redeem body for the marketplace-checkout use case the spec calls out.

backend/services/games_v2.py:554-627 — seed_extra_house_games heals `end_at` back to None on existing house campaigns but does NOT heal `status` back to 'active'. If an admin ever paused one of these, the seed won't re-activate it — which is arguably correct, but noting it for spec clarity: 'always-on' currently means 'never expires', not 'never paused'.
